NVIDIA Q2 Earnings Beat on Blackwell Ultra & Data Center Strength NVIDIA delivered another strong quarterly performance as AI infrastructure demand lifted second-quarter fiscal 2027 results above expectations.
Non-GAAP earnings of $2.22 per share for the second quarter rose 120% year over year and beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 6.22%.
Revenues surged 106% year over year to $96.22 billion and surpassed the consensus mark by 4.82%.

NVDA's Data Center Growth Broadens Beyond Hyperscale Data Center revenues jumped 117% year over year and 18% sequentially to $89.02 billion, with Blackwell Ultra infrastructure driving the record performance.
Within the Data Center segment, Hyperscale revenues climbed 102% year over year and 13% sequentially to $48.71 billion, supported by Blackwell Ultra demand.
AI Clouds, Industrial and Enterprise revenues advanced 138% year over year and 25% sequentially to $40.31 billion.
China Hopper shipments were less than 1% of Data Center revenues.
